moves.name: Relic Song of Wonder
moves.description:
Activation Condition:
When the user is not in a pinch.
Deactivation Condition:
When the user is in a pinch. Never misses. Has a chance (%) of putting the target to sleep. Raises the critical-hit rate of all allied sync pairs by stat ranks. Raises one of the following stats of all allied sync pairs by stat ranks at random: Attack, Defense, Sp. Atk, Sp. Def, Speed, accuracy, or evasiveness. (The same stat is raised for all allied sync pairs.)

passives.name: Unova Flag Bearer
passives.description: Powers up the moves of all allied sync pairs by %. Reduces attack move damage taken by all allied sync pairs by %. The more allied sync pairs with the Unova theme you have on your team, the higher these percentages are. (Each additional sync pair powers up moves by % and reduces damage by 3%. The maximum power-up is %, and the maximum damage reduction is %.)

passives.description: Switches between Aria Forme and Pirouette Forme when the user’s attack move or sync move which includes in its name is successful. Increases the Physical Moves ↑ Next effect and Special Moves ↑ Next effect of all allied sync pairs by ranks when the user changes forms while it is on the field of play.
